sceneLabel: Silhouettes of Goldfinger and Oddjob in front of a vault
opening: The copy is stuck to the bomb's core. And no, you can't peel it off without defusing it first.
clues: 1. Don't touch the color of Le Chiffre's tears.
2. The right one is the color of the casino felt.
3. The pale wires are Q's decoys.
selectHint: Tap a wire to select it, then tap again to cut.
success: Seven seconds. He always leaves everything to the last minute.
successLate: Not even seven seconds. Q is going to need a cup of tea.
fail: The gold is intact; you, barely. Again, calmly.
nightLabel: The gold fades and everything turns night blue. It starts to snow.
laserLabel: Cut the selected wire with the laser watch, no penalty
